essence: The direction guardians in the outer directions are to be envisioned bearing the mace, spear, boon, and bow.
The practitioner should mutter one hundred thousand times and offer lotuses with sweet speech into the fire.
An alternative method for performing the preliminary rite of this practice is now being taught.
By offering a tenth part in the fire, the practitioner becomes accomplished in the preliminary rite.
The preliminary rite produces wealth, grain, land, and other prosperities without doubt.
